features: 22-INCH FHD PANEL - The PRO MP225 E12L features a 22-inch IPS panel (178° wide viewing angle) with Full-HD (1920x1080) resolution; A high 120 Hz refresh rate (1ms MPRT) improves the day-to-day visual experience with smoother, faster frame rates

IMAGE QUALITY - The PRO MP225 E12L supports a superior 119% sRGB color gamut (6 bits + FRC, 16.7M colors), 300 nits brightness & high 1300:1 contrast ratio; MSI Display Kit App unlocks extra display, productivity & color settings

LESS BLUE LIGHT - TÜV Rheinland Eye Comfort certified features include Less Blue Light filters & Anti-Flicker technology; Employs anti-glare surface treatment, default eco-mode settings, and Eye-Q Check functionality (via OSD menu)
SIMPLE YET FLEXIBLE - The monitor comes with 100mm VESA brackets for wall or arm mounting (e.g., MSI VESA Arm MAG MT201W), while the stand is a tilt-adjustable ergonomic stand
MULTIPLE CONNECTIVITY - Supports three connectivity options with HDMI 1.4b (1920x1080/120Hz) and D-Sub (VGA) (1920x1080/60Hz), Adaptive Sync supported; Includes Kensington Lock
